```{r setup}
#| include: false
targets::tar_config_set(
  store = if (dir.exists("_targets")) "_targets" else "../_targets"
)

library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 120)
status_pal <- c(pass = "#2E8B57", warn = "#E0A100", fail = "#C0392B")
```

## Overview

This report is generated by the `ices-data-qa` pipeline. It assesses data served by the [ICES Stock Assessment Graphs API](https://sag.ices.dk/SAG_API/) across three tiers: **structural** (schema, completeness, uniqueness), **statistical** (plausibility of values) and **timeliness** (recency and continuity of the yearly series).

```{r overview}
#| results: asis
qa_all <- tar_read(qa_all)
qa_status <- tar_read(qa_status)

cat(sprintf("**Overall status: `%s`** — based on %d checks.\n",
            toupper(qa_status), nrow(qa_all)))

knitr::kable(tar_read(qa_overview),
             caption = "Number of checks by tier and outcome")
```

## Findings requiring attention

```{r findings}
qa_all |>
  filter(status != "pass") |>
  arrange(status, category, check) |>
  select(category, check, column, n_issues, n_rows, detail) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Checks that warned or failed")
```

## Outcome distribution

```{r plot-status}
#| fig-cap: "Share of checks by outcome and QA tier"
qa_all |>
  count(category, status) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = category, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of checks", fill = "Outcome") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Time coverage of sampled series

```{r plot-coverage}
#| fig-cap: "Year coverage of the sampled SAG summary series"
tar_read(summary_tbl) |>
  group_by(AssessmentKey) |>
  summarise(min_year = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_year = max(Year, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(factor(AssessmentKey), min_year))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = min_year, xend = max_year, yend = factor(AssessmentKey)),
               linewidth = 3, colour = "#2E8B57", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Assessment key") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Reproducibility

-   Pipeline orchestrated with [`targets`](https://docs.ropensci.org/targets/); re-run end-to-end with `targets::tar_make()`.
-   Unit tests (`testthat`) run on every push via GitHub Actions.
-   Full dependency versions pinned with `renv` (see README).
